claim: The third quarter of fiscal 2024 revenue result fell 17% year over year at Microsoft.
summary: Microsoft's fiscal Q3 2024 (quarter ended March 31, 2024) revenue was $61.9B, up ~17% year-over-year from ~$52.9B in fiscal Q3 2023, not down 17%. The claim inverts the direction of the reported change.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's revenue in the third quarter of fiscal 2024 declined year-over-year
sub_claims.stated_text: fell ... year over year at Microsoft
sub_claims.note: Without tools, parametric knowledge indicates revenue increased ~17% YoY ($61.9B vs ~$52.9B in Q3 FY2023), contradicting a decline; no tool evidence available.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft's fiscal Q3 2024 year-over-year revenue change was a 17% decrease (-17%)
sub_claims.note: Actual reported YoY change was approximately +17% (increase), not -17%; magnitude 17% is correct in absolute terms but sign/direction is inverted.
